attchmntText: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 60000 securities pursuant to Non Convertible Securities at its meeting held on November 18, 2026
voiceSummary: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has approved the allotment of 60,000 zero coupon, secured, redeemable, rated, listed, non-convertible debentures. The Finance Committee authorized this allotment via resolution dated November 18, 2026. Each debenture has a face value of 1,00,000 rupees. The total issue size amounts to 600,00,00,000 rupees. The instrument is designated as PFL NCD SERIES ZCB H2 FY 2026-27. The tenure is 1,826 days, equivalent to 5 years. The date of allotment is November 18, 2026. The maturity date is Tuesday, November 18, 2031. The debentures carry a zero coupon rate. They are secured by a first ranking pari passu charge on hypothecated properties. The securities will be listed in the Debt Market Segment of BSE Limited.

attchmntText: Seamec Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Deployment Status of Vessel SEAMEC PRINCESS'.
voiceSummary: SEAMEC Limited disclosed that its vessel SEAMEC PRINCESS experienced a technical snag while at the WIN North Platform and pulled out of the field on 18th November 2026 at 02:30 hours IST. The company stated that after redressal of the issue, the vessel will be redeployed. Suitable intimation regarding the redeployment will be provided subsequently. The information was received on 18th November 2026 at 08:19 hours. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.

attchmntText: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR), 2015 Order of the Supreme Court of India in response to appeal under Section 62 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
voiceSummary: Value Industries Limited intimates that the Supreme Court of India dismissed appeals under Section 62 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, vide order dated November 16, 2026. The Court rejected Civil Appeal Nos. 894, 512, and 509 of 2022 filed by the Successful Resolution Applicant. The Court also dismissed Civil Appeal No. 1307 of 2022, Civil Appeal Nos. 8659 to 8661 of 2026, Civil Appeal Nos. 8718 and 8719 of 2026, and Civil Appeal Diary Nos. 41234 and 41286 of 2026 concerning foreign oil and gas assets. No order was passed regarding costs. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by NCLT order dated 05th September, 2018.
